content.text:
ok so working on the connect screen for engelbart. user lands here right after signup. we list: Claude, ChatGPT, Zotero, Google Drive, Gmail, Slack, local folders, Obsidian.

current copy:
header: "Connect your tools"
sub: "Engelbart imports your stuff so it can help you think."

this is bad lol. give me 5 header/sub options. be concise, no marketing fluff

Here are five, each with a different angle:

1. **Bring in where your thinking already lives**
   Connect the tools you research in. Engelbart keeps track of where every idea came from.

2. **Start from what you already have**
   Import your chats, papers and notes so your notebook isn't empty on day one.

3. **Connect your sources**
   Every item keeps a link back to the tool and the moment it came from.

4. **Your research is already scattered. Let's gather it.**
   Pick the tools you use. You can add more later.

5. **What should Engelbart read first?**
   Choose the places your work happens. Nothing is shared or posted anywhere.

If you want my pick: 3 is the most honest about what the product does (provenance), and 5 is the friendliest. 4 risks sounding like a lecture.
i like 3. but "moment it came from" is a bit precious. also need per-source helper text, one line each, what we import and what we dont

Revised header:

**Connect your sources**
Every item keeps a link back to where it came from.

Per-source helper text:

| Source | Helper line |
|---|---|
| Claude | Your chats and projects. Not your account settings or memory. |
| ChatGPT | Your conversations, including those in Projects. Not custom GPTs. |
| Zotero | Items, notes and attached PDFs from My Library and groups you choose. |
| Google Drive | Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDFs in folders you pick. Not the whole Drive. |
| Gmail | Threads with labels you choose. Nothing else from your inbox. |
| Slack | Channels you pick from workspaces you're in. Not DMs unless you add them. |
| Local folder | Files in one folder on this computer. We read, never change them. |
| Obsidian | Notes and attachments from a vault. Links between notes are kept. |

Two things to decide before this ships: whether Gmail defaults to "labels you choose" (safer, more setup) or "last 12 months" (easier, noisier), and whether Slack DMs are opt-in at all.
for claude we do the export zip OR the browser session. dont mention the browser thing yet. also say roughly how long each takes

Sure. I'd keep times as ranges and say what they depend on, otherwise people read them as promises.

| Source | Helper line | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Claude | Upload your data export (.zip). Chats and projects come in; settings don't. | 1–5 min after upload |
| ChatGPT | Upload your data export (.zip). Includes chats inside Projects. | 1–5 min |
| Zotero | Items, notes and PDFs from libraries you choose. | 2–10 min, depends on PDFs |
| Google Drive | Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDFs in folders you pick. | 1–10 min |
| Gmail | Threads under labels you choose. | under 5 min for most labels |
| Slack | Channels you pick. DMs only if you add them. | 1–3 min per channel |
| Local folder | Files in one folder. Read only. | depends on folder size |
| Obsidian | A vault's notes and attachments, with links kept. | under 2 min |

Small note: the Claude export email can take a while to arrive, so the helper for Claude might need a "How to get your export" link, otherwise people will stall right there.
yeah good call. what should the button say after connecting but while import is still running

Three states, so the button never lies:

- **Before**: `Connect`
- **While running**: `Importing… 214 items` (live count, not a percentage, because you don't know the total up front for most sources)
- **Done**: `Connected · 1,032 items` with a small `View` link

And for the page-level button at the bottom:

- While anything is still running: `Continue to notebook` (enabled) with a line under it: "Imports keep running in the background."
- Don't block them on the import finishing. The worst onboarding is a progress bar you have to watch.

If an import partially fails, show `Connected · 980 items · 52 skipped` and make "skipped" clickable so they can see why. That will also help you in pilots, since "skipped" is where silent omissions hide.
